about: Modwerk source-only flanger package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/flanger. A send effect: the site builds it on the Modwerk base's send-bus variant.

mods.title: FLANGER
mods.summary: A barber-pole flanger for the Rytm's send bus: the sweep rises or falls without end, the right side against the left.
mods.description: A barber-pole flanger for the Rytm's send bus: the sweep rises or falls without end, the right side against the left.
mods.author: stigmagit
mods.on_unit: Test build MB02, with the same source built locally, ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as the author reported; this package has not run on a unit.
